description: Versioned TypeSafe question templates for Visual QA v3. Slots are replaced by the state key of the scenario's image. No question is generated by a model at run time.

templates.instructions: Is a landscape built from green and brown cube-shaped blocks, with steps and sharp block edges, visible in `{shot}`?
templates.interpretation: yes means block terrain is on screen; expected value comes from the scenario
templates.calibration: v2 wording, frozen (scene-smoke-v2 terrain_visible); v2 evaluation: unsure on 4 of 10

templates.interpretation: the top option is compared with the scenario's expected class (block_landscape); correct when its probability is >= 0.5
templates.calibration: v2 wording, frozen (scene_kind); v2 evaluation: 10 of 10 correct on landscapes, no non-landscape picture was tested

criteria.block_landscape: A landscape of green and brown cube-shaped blocks with sky above
criteria.blank_or_background_only: A blank frame or only background colour, without any blocky ground

templates.instructions: Is there an area in `{shot}` where plain dark background shows through, with ground visible around it on at least two sides?
templates.interpretation: yes means a gap in the ground; for a healthy scene expect no (steps and the finite world edge are normal)
templates.calibration: v2 wording, frozen (terrain-integrity-v2 gap_in_ground); v2 evaluation: fired on 4 of 4 missing/hidden areas, healthy pictures sat at 0.51-0.60 (unsure)

templates.instructions: Is there a block-shaped patch on the ground in `{shot}` whose colour is clearly neither green, brown nor grey?
templates.interpretation: yes means a wrong-material patch; for a healthy scene expect no
templates.calibration: v2 wording, frozen (off_palette_patch); v2 evaluation: 2 of 2 wrong materials fired, 6 of 6 clean pictures answered no

templates.instructions: Do the upper surfaces of cube-shaped terrain blocks fill most of `{shot}`, as in a view looking straight down from above?
templates.interpretation: yes means a top-down view of terrain
templates.calibration: NEW, uncalibrated: not measured on any picture yet

templates.instructions: Is sky visible across the upper part of `{shot}`?
templates.interpretation: yes means sky in the upper part; expected value comes from the camera pitch of the scenario
templates.calibration: NEW, uncalibrated: not measured on any picture yet

templates.instructions: Does a flat shape that is not part of the landscape cover the middle of `{shot}`, so that the ground behind it cannot be seen?
templates.interpretation: yes means the centre of the view is blocked by an overlay or a stray object; a small panel in a corner does not count
templates.calibration: NEW, uncalibrated: not measured on any picture yet

templates.instructions: Compared with `{before}`, is one block missing near the middle of `{after}`, leaving a pit or notch that `{before}` does not have?
templates.interpretation: yes means a block was removed; slots are enlarged crops around the crosshair
templates.calibration: v2 wording, frozen (block-edit-v2); v2 result: did not detect either real one-block edit (0.49, 0.58); use only for comparison
